name: The Fishing Derby
description: Anglers at the lake-country derby each landed a different fish from a different pond on a different lure. Work out who caught what, and where.
clues: Either Boone goes with Cedarmere or someone in the Catfish Family goes with Mossbank.
Catfish, Cedarmere, and Foxglen go with Boone, Dale, and Wade, in some order.
Boone, Dale, and Gus go with Carp, Crappie, and Foxglen, in some order.
If Dale does not go with Carp, then both Mossbank goes with Crappie and no one in the South Watershed goes with Gus.
